svg.metadata: {"props":{"layout":{"auto":true,"children":[{"id":"shopper","label":"Shopper"},{"id":"site","label":"Web shop"},{"id":"stock","label":"In stock?","shape":"decision"},{"label":"Order handling","children":[{"id":"cart","label":"Order"},{"id":"pay","label":"Payment"},{"id":"ship","label":"Shipping"}]},{"id":"db","label":"Orders","shape":"store"},{"id":"mail","label":"Email"},{"id":"wait","label":"Back order"}]},"edges":[{"from":"shopper","to":"site","label":"checkout"},{"from":"site","to":"stock"},{"from":"stock","to":"cart","label":"yes"},{"from":"stock","to":"wait","label":"no"},{"from":"cart","to":"pay"},{"from":"pay","to":"ship"},{"from":"ship","to":"db","label":"save"},{"from":"ship","to":"mail","label":"notify"}],"steps":[{"label":"Item in stock","flow":[{"edges":"shopper->site","say":"The shopper starts the checkout."},{"edges":"site->stock","say":"The shop checks the stock."},{"edges":"stock->cart","say":"The item is in stock, so the order starts."},{"edges":"cart->pay","say":"The shopper pays for the order."},{"edges":"pay->ship","say":"The shop ships the order."},{"edges":"ship->mail","say":"The shopper gets a ship email."}]},{"label":"Item sold out","flow":[{"edges":"shopper->site","say":"The shopper starts the checkout."},{"edges":"site->stock","say":"The shop checks the stock."},{"edges":"stock->wait","say":"The item is sold out, so the order waits."}]}]}}
svg.title: Flow figure: Shopper, Web shop, In stock?, Order, Payment, Shipping, Back order, Email, Orders. Steps: Item in stock, Item sold out.
svg.desc: The figure has these boxes: Shopper, Web shop, In stock?, Order, Payment, Shipping, Back order, Email, Orders. Item in stock. The shopper starts the checkout. The shop checks the stock. The item is in stock, so the order starts. The shopper pays for the order. The shop ships the order. The shopper gets a ship email. Item sold out. The shopper starts the checkout. The shop checks the stock. The item is sold out, so the order waits.

g.text: The item is in stock, so the order starts.
The shopper pays for the order.
The shopper gets a ship email.
The item is sold out, so the order waits.
